definition: Default EC2 metrics arrive every 5 minutes, or every minute with detailed monitoring. Remember: memory and disk space need the unified CloudWatch agent, which also ships log files.
Streams matching log events in near real time to Kinesis Data Streams, Data Firehose, or Lambda, even across accounts. Remember: export to S3 is a slow batch job.
Analyzes log data to show the top contributors, such as the IP addresses sending the most traffic in VPC Flow Logs. Remember: think "top N talkers".
Event history keeps 90 days of management events for free. For longer retention, create a trail to S3 and query it with Athena. Remember: data events are off by default.
CloudTrail answers who made which API call. Config answers how a resource was configured over time and whether it complies. CloudWatch covers performance metrics, logs, and alarms.
Config rules check resource settings against managed or custom rules, and can auto-remediate with Systems Manager Automation. Remember: Config detects and fixes afterwards; it never blocks API calls.
Cheapest to fastest: backup and restore, pilot light, warm standby, multi-site. RPO is how much data you can lose. RTO is how long you can be down.
Pilot light runs only the core, like a replicated database, and launches servers during failover. Warm standby runs a scaled-down full copy that can serve traffic immediately.

Both use continuous block-level replication into a low-cost staging area. Elastic Disaster Recovery keeps servers ready for failover. Application Migration Service moves them to AWS once, for lift and shift.

term: AWS DMS Full Load and CDC
definition: Database Migration Service copies existing data, then change data capture keeps the target in sync while the source stays online. Remember: different engines need schema conversion first.
Write once, read many protection for a backup vault. Remember: in compliance mode, once the grace period ends, nobody, including the root user, can delete backups or shorten retention.
Transcribe turns speech into text and can automatically redact personal data. Polly turns text into lifelike speech, tuned with SSML and pronunciation lexicons.
Comprehend finds sentiment, entities, key phrases, and language in text. Comprehend Medical extracts medical terms and protected health information from clinical notes.
Extracts printed and handwritten text, forms, and tables from scanned documents such as invoices, IDs, and tax forms. Remember: documents in, structured data out.

Machine learning document search that answers natural language questions. Closed to new customers since July 2026; AWS suggests Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases instead. It may still appear on the exam.
An IAM role that CloudFormation assumes to create stack resources. Users only need the iam:PassRole permission for it, so they can deploy stacks without holding those permissions directly.
AWS-managed racks or servers in your own data center that run services like EC2 and EBS, for low latency or data residency. Remember: you handle physical security.
Email, SMS, and push campaigns. Closed to new customers in May 2025, ending October 30, 2026. SMS and push move to AWS End User Messaging, email to SES.
With CloudFront in front, use an AWS WAF IP set, because network ACLs only see CloudFront addresses. Without CloudFront, a network ACL deny works. Security groups cannot deny.
Six pillars: operational excellence, security, reliability, performance efficiency, cost optimization, and sustainability. Remember: the free Well-Architected Tool reviews workloads against them.
